To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the quantum Hall resistance standard has been successfully established at NIM, and the measurement uncertainty of the quantum Hall standard is 2.4×10-8 at 4.2 K, which is comparable with the international standard.
we have obtained a single quantum Hall device with good performance, and the measurement resolution of the device is on the level of ~10-7.
a quantum Hall resistance standard with the resistance value of 1 Ω and a relative standard uncertainty of 1.2 × 10−8 can be realized in NIM.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of the resistance quantum Hall device as an alternative standard for resistance metrology.
the development of quantum Hall resistance as the resistance standard for the NIM.
the investigation of the single quantum Hall device as a resistance standard for the NIM.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the NIM single QHE device is ready for the resistance standard.
the single quantum Hall device is a good candidate to replace the transfer resistance standards in the future.
a single quantum Hall device can be a resistance standard for the resistance metrology.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an effective way for the fabrication of the single quantum Hall devices with good reproducibility and stability.
the single quantum Hall devices with high stability and low noise can be used as the resistance standard in NMI.
we have developed the capability of measuring the quantum Hall resistance in NIM.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the measurement resolution of quantum Hall device is limited by the current comparator.
the measurement uncertainty is dominated by the DCC measurement uncertainty.
the quantum Hall device is a very promising resistance standard.
